title: Model ML Opens Its Paris office - Model ML
summary: Model ML opens its Paris office to meet growing demand from French financial institutions, led by alumni of Rothschild & Co and Bain & Company.
body_markdown:
Model ML today announced that it has opened its office in Paris.


Demand for Model ML from French financial institutions has been exceptional this year, and it is still accelerating.


Keeping up with that pace means having people on the ground. The Paris office brings Model ML's team closer to its clients in France, so they can work alongside them day to day, in French, and respond as quickly as those firms are moving.


The office is led by a founding team of two, both of whom have done the work Model ML's clients do, at the level those clients expect:


-


**Marouane Chahri** , Engagement Manager (previously Rothschild & Co)


-


**Antoine Aldon** , Engagement Manager (previously Bain & Company)


Model ML is hiring in France. If you want to help build Model ML there, see our open roles: https://modelml.com/careers
